narrative.details:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then.

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Rianni Nightwind and list to what he has to say.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for scavenging these materials. I imagine that some of this wasn't terribly easy to get.With these parts I can get the construct up and running again. From there we can just hope that its memory is intact and it can tell us who took its components.
narrative.requestItemsText: I can't imagine why anyone would want to steal these components from this construct. Other than the gyrozephyr these components have almost no practical application. Even the gyro would be nigh-useless outside of its intended purpose.

mentionedItems.name: Crystallized Lightning
tooltip: "The surface of this object is smooth to the touch and makes the hair on the back of your neck stand up when you hold it."

mentionedItems.name: Enchanted Gyrozephyr
tooltip: "This object softly vibrates, constantly in a state of perpetual motion. If you try to hold it still, the force it exerts increases greatly in intensity."

mentionedItems.name: Air Construct Core
tooltip: "The glowing orb seems to be looking at you, following your movements with quiet curiosity."
